name: Disciplinary - SCN
subject: Show Cause Notice Issued for {{ doc.employee_name }} – Case Type: {{ doc.case_type }}
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.employee_name }},


This is to inform you that a disciplinary case of type "{{ doc.case_type }}" has been initiated by HR Department for the employee {{ doc.employee_name }} (Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}).


Case Details:
Case ID: {{ doc.case_id }}
Branch: {{ doc.branch_name }}
Issue Date: {{ doc.issue_occurrence_date.strftime('%d-%m-%Y') if doc.issue_occurrence_date else '' }}
Initiated By: HR Department


The Show Cause Notice has been generated and forwarded to the respective branch for further action.

{% if doc.document_upload %}


Please find the relevant document(s) attached:
{{ doc.document_upload }}

{% endif %}


Remarks:
{{ doc.remarks }}


Regards,
HR Department
